usage.note: Official PlatformIO RaspberryPi1.20.0 board=pico, Arduino-mbed (not earlephilhower). Installed Arduino-mbed4.6.0 RASPBERRY_PI_PICO variant.cpp explicitly maps D0–D29 to p0–p29 and has empty initVariant; pins_arduino.h maps A0–A3 to26–29. Default Wire uses GP4/5; optional GP20/21 bus needs mbed::I2C or MbedI2C configured explicitly, not unmodified global Wire. no onboardLED/VSYS divider/SMPS hardware is implied. Motoroutputs GP14/15 defaultLOW/coast before PWM. GP26–29ADC inputs must stay within actualADC_AVDD; conservativeexternalinputportmax3.234V. Do not repurpose QSPI/crystal/USB/RUN/TESTEN/debug pins or disable/change1.1V regulator.2MB flash/12MHz clock compatible configuration still needs sandbox compile and native/electrical review. All currentbudgets are bounded author estimates; core regulator100mArating is distinct from fault currentlimit. Keep QSPI/crystal/decaps short andUSB differential return/impedance qualified; no nativeDRC,hardware,current/clock/ESD certification or independentpromotion is claimed.

MCU must drive IN1/IN2 using output-capable pins; speedPWM additionally requires actual PWM capability (RP2040 agreed GP14/15). Port schema has no PWM-requirement field, so plan review must check MCU facts. Set both pinsLOW before enabling OUTPUT, wait>=1ms afterVM valid (2ms authorpolicy). 00coast,10forward,01reverse,11brake; fast-decay speedPWM appliesPWM toonepin whileotherLOW. Use targetcore analogWrite/digitalWrite, no extra library. Startspeed0, clampduty, coast before reversing; software is not stall/current/temperature protection. Fixedsleep47k is alwaysenabled, no shutdownGPIO. Never ground either motor terminal or route motor current through3.3VLDO. Qualify motor/supply startup, stall, USBinrush, EMI, regeneration/braking, effectivecaps andthermalbehavior; no hardware-fit/manufacturing claim.
